complex.metaDescription: Services, equipment, specialists, and clinical practice at the Saribekyan university medical complex.
complex.title: University
complex.description: Healthcare, education, research, and innovation within one integrated healthcare ecosystem.

about.title: About the Medical Complex
about.p1: The Saribekyan International Medical University Medical Complex is a modern healthcare ecosystem that brings together clinical care, education, research, and innovation within one integrated environment.
about.p2: Its activities are grounded in the principles of patient-centred, evidence-based, and multidisciplinary medicine. Clinical care is closely integrated with the education of future physicians, continuing professional development of healthcare professionals, and scientific research.
about.p3: The Medical Complex aims to foster an academic and clinical environment where every patient receives high-quality and safe healthcare, while students and healthcare professionals are empowered to learn, develop, and contribute to the advancement of modern medicine.
about.tagline: Care. Education. Research. Innovation. One integrated ecosystem.

anesthesia.title: Anesthesia and Intensive Care Clinic
anesthesia.description: Modern anesthesia, perioperative medical care, and intensive care services.

surgery.title: Surgical Clinic
surgery.description: Contemporary surgical care spanning diagnosis and preoperative assessment, surgery, and postoperative follow-up.

therapy.title: Internal Medicine Clinic
therapy.description: Comprehensive assessment, diagnosis, treatment, and ongoing medical management of internal diseases.

diagnostics.title: Diagnostic Center
diagnostics.description: Laboratory, instrumental, and functional diagnostics supporting accurate and informed clinical decision-making.

pain.title: National Center for Pain Medicine
pain.description: Comprehensive assessment and multidisciplinary management of acute and chronic pain using contemporary pharmacological, non-pharmacological, and interventional approaches.

services.intro: Services are organized across the Medical Complex’s clinics and centers: Anesthesia and Intensive Care Clinic • Surgical Clinic • Internal Medicine Clinic • Diagnostic Center • National Center for Pain Medicine.

outpatient.title: Outpatient Medical Care
outpatient.description: Specialist consultations, diagnostics, treatment, medical follow-up, and appropriate procedures provided through the relevant clinics and centers of the Medical Complex.

inpatient.title: Inpatient Medical Care
inpatient.description: Round-the-clock medical supervision, treatment, surgical and other specialized procedures, anesthesia, intensive care, and post-treatment management according to the relevant clinical pathway.

practice.intro: As a university medical complex, we integrate healthcare delivery, clinical experience, and professional development. Our clinical environment supports clinical observation, professional discussion, practical skills development, and knowledge exchange while maintaining the principles of patient safety, confidentiality, and medical ethics.

learning.title: Clinical Learning
learning.description: Development of knowledge and practical skills within a real clinical environment.

rounds.title: Clinical Rounds & Case Discussions
rounds.description: Clinical case review and professional discussion through a multidisciplinary approach.

skills.title: Practical Skills
skills.description: Development of clinical and practical competencies in accordance with professional and safety standards.

development.title: Professional Development
development.description: An environment supporting knowledge exchange, continuing education, and professional growth.

equipment.intro: The University Medical Complex is equipped with modern medical technologies and equipment supporting a broad spectrum of diagnostic, therapeutic, surgical and interventional procedures, anesthesia, intensive care, rehabilitation, and continuous patient monitoring.

surgical.title: Surgical & Laparoscopic Technology
surgical.description: A modern operating theatre equipped for open and laparoscopic surgery, with the technology and instrumentation required for safe surgical care and contemporary minimally invasive procedures.

anesthesia.title: Anesthesia & Intensive Care
anesthesia.description: Modern anesthesia workstations, multiparameter patient monitors, and systems for monitoring and supporting vital functions. The supporting infrastructure includes medical gas, suction, infusion therapy, and perioperative monitoring solutions.

mobileImaging.title: Intraoperative & Mobile Imaging
mobileImaging.description: A mobile C-arm imaging system for intraoperative imaging and image-guided interventional procedures, complemented by mobile radiography for imaging at the patient’s location when clinically required.

ultrasound.title: Imaging & Ultrasound Diagnostics
ultrasound.description: Digital fixed radiography, bone densitometry, a broad range of ultrasound examinations, and echocardiography.

functional.title: Functional Diagnostics
functional.description: Electrocardiography (ECG), Holter monitoring, spirometry, audiometry, and tympanometry.

neuro.title: Neurophysiological Diagnostics & Neuromodulation
neuro.description: Electroencephalography (EEG), electroneuromyography (ENMG), and transcranial magnetic stimulation (TMS) for functional assessment of the nervous system and appropriate clinical applications.

endoscopy.title: Endoscopic Diagnostics
endoscopy.description: Modern endoscopic systems for upper gastrointestinal endoscopy (gastroscopy) and colonoscopy.

laser.title: Laser & Vascular Technology
laser.description: A modern vascular laser system supporting minimally invasive treatment of appropriate vascular conditions, including endovenous laser procedures.

rehab.title: Physiotherapy & Rehabilitation
rehab.description: A broad spectrum of core physiotherapy modalities and modern rehabilitation equipment supporting restoration of mobility, improvement of functional capacity, and individualized rehabilitation programmes.

lab.title: Laboratory Diagnostics
lab.description: Laboratory technologies and equipment supporting clinical, biochemical, immunological, and serological testing.

chief.title: Chief Medical Officer
chief.description: Overall clinical leadership of the Medical Complex, with responsibility for quality and safety of care, coordination of clinical services, and strategic clinical development.

inpatient.title: Deputy Chief Medical Officer for Inpatient Services
inpatient.description: Coordination of inpatient medical care, clinical processes, continuity of treatment, and patient safety.

outpatient.title: Deputy Chief Medical Officer for Outpatient Services
outpatient.description: Coordination of outpatient medical care, integration of specialist services, and effective organization of patient care pathways.

dental.title: Dental
dental.description: Dental treatment and student practice with modern units and specialist supervision.

about.title: About the centre
about.p1: The dental centre is part of the university clinical base and provides therapeutic, surgical, and preventive services.
about.p2: Students practise chairside, starting with supervised procedures and moving toward independent work.

lab.intro: Our dental laboratory is a core department of the modern dental complex, where digital technology and medical precision come together to create high-quality prosthetic and implant solutions.
lab.digital: Digital modelling and design: each construction is planned around the patient’s individual anatomy.
lab.prosthetics: Fixed and removable prosthetics: zirconia, all-ceramic, and metal-ceramic crowns, veneers, and clasp or flexible dentures.
lab.implants: Implant prosthetics: complex orthopaedic constructions and custom abutments.
lab.team: Our experienced dental technicians work closely with dentists to deliver high-quality work, biocompatible materials, and short turnaround times.
lab.goal: Our aim is to restore the function of the patient’s dentition and provide a natural, confident smile.
